טבלה: תנאי פוליסת ביטוח נסיעות
This table details the limits of liability and deductibles for various coverage types within a travel insurance policy. It allows you to look up coverage based on the section in the policy and the type of event.
ממדים: Section in Policy / Coverage type, Coverage details (Limit of liability, Deductible)

Section in Policy,Coverage,Limit of liability,Deductible
15.5,Loss of payments abroad in the event of a Medical Event due to an epidemic,"$150 stay expenses per day and up to a maximum amount of $1,000",No deductible
15.7,Increasing the reimbursement ceiling for expansion for canceling and shortening a trip during an epidemic: (for additional insurance premiums),Increasing the reimbursement ceiling for expansion for canceling and shortening a trip during an epidemic: (for additional insurance premiums),Increasing the reimbursement ceiling for expansion for canceling and shortening a trip during an epidemic: (for additional insurance premiums)
15.7.1,Trip cancellation Out of which: travel ticket for an Insured,"$150 stay expenses and up to a total amount of $5,000 $2,000",
15.7.2,Extending or shortening a stay abroad,"$150 stay expenses and up to a total of $5,000",
Chapter 15B,Cancellation of a trip and shortening of a trip - Extended,,
15.2 B,Cancellation of a trip Within it: ticket for the insured,"$10,000 $3,000",$50
15.3 B,Shortening of a trip Within it: ticket for the insured,"$12,000 $3,000",$50
15.3.2,Travel plan change - without travel shortening,"$1,000",$50
15.4,Reimbursement for a canceled ticket in the event of a medical event due to an epidemic,$400,No deductible
15.5,Loss of payments abroad in the event of a medical event due to an epidemic,"$150 stay expenses and up to a maximum amount of $1,000",No deductible
